preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 32000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(char in '{}[]()' for char in input)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only the characters '{', '}', '(', ')', '[' and ']'.

postconditions.expression: output == True if balanced else False
postconditions.description: The output is a boolean indicating whether the brackets in the input string are balanced.
